title: ERPNext 15 purchase order, Standard print format, Monochrome print style, image letter head, US Letter, 3 pages
notes: Purchase Order PUR-ORD-2026-00001, submitted, dated 2026-10-14, required by 2026-11-05, supplier Terres & Émaux du Rhône SAS, target warehouse "Stores - AK", 8 lines (MAT-ARG-25 500 kg x 1.38, MAT-POR-12 100 kg x 3.40, MAT-EMA-BLP 10 kg x 18.50, MAT-EMA-CEL 10 kg x 21.00, MAT-EMA-SAB 5 kg x 19.20, MAT-EMA-TRA 15 kg x 12.40, MAT-OXY-COB 500 g x 0.19, MAT-KAO-25 50 kg x 0.96), net 1 850.00 EUR, VAT 20 % 370.00, total 2 220.00, terms "Conditions générales d'achat", supplier address, contact and company billing address blocks. Print Settings: print style Monochrome, PDF page size Letter; other settings as the defaults. Letter Head Atelier Kiln Achats, chosen in the print view (the default letter head stays Atelier Kiln). Captured from Frappe 15.124.0 (commit f1cf50cf9bbc) + ERPNext 15.124.1 (commit 4e0dce9ea8d3), printed through HTTP /api/method/frappe.utils.print_format.download_pdf with a logged-in session, as the print view's PDF button does. Frappe (pdfkit 1.0.0) pipes the page on stdin and reads the PDF from stdout: `-` `-` at the end; the output `-` is replaced by {out}. Frappe passed `--cookie-jar /tmp/<random>.jar` (session cookie sid); that pair is removed. /tmp/frappe-pdf-<random>.html header and footer files became input/header.html and input/footer.html. No margin-top or margin-bottom is passed: the header and footer heights decide the margins. The footer page inlines the whole print CSS; the header page links it. JavaScript is disabled for the page but the footer's subst() still fills the page numbers. Origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 rewritten to http://127.0.0.1:8765 in input/page.html, input/header.html, input/footer.html (no www/ file contained it). www lists the entry's own files (if any) then corpus/_shared/erpnext15/www (print CSS print.bundle.7DKZWKDD.css, same content as H34JAH53 of the first two ERPNext entries but for three comments, and the Atelier Kiln logo). httpHeaders are the Cache-Control values the Frappe server sent. The print CSS has no @font-face: the text relies on fonts installed on the machine. ERPNext parts are GPL-3.0; Frappe parts are MIT; the print CSS also bundles Bootstrap 3.3.1, normalize.css and HTML5 Boilerplate (MIT) and Quill 2.0.3 CSS (BSD-3-Clause); letter heads, images and business data were written for the corpus. See SOURCE.md.
